title: ZipCPU (ZipCPU/zipcpu)
_note: ZipCPU core (rtl/core), its execution units (rtl/ex), peripherals and DMA, and the
wrappers in rtl/.  The formal properties live under `ifdef FORMAL and are not
compiled; sim/rtl holds simulation-only models and is left out.
First local sweep 2026-10-26 (51 rows): 47 / 50 comparable proven, 50 / 50
elaborate, 0 undriven, 49 co-sim PASS.  Open: two SAT-budget rows (cpuops,
mpyop -- the 32-bit multiplier and its operand mux, both co-sim PASS) and
zipmmu, whose 20 co-simulated divergences are a SURELOG defect, not a reader
one: an always block inside a bare `generate ... endgenerate` region that
also declares a variable (`generate integer i; always @(posedge) ...`) is
dropped from UHDM entirely, so the TLB priority encoder has no driver.
zipwb has no read_slang reference ($finish in a non-simulation path).
